0.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_100_000
0.description: Oh, how I envy the amaro. In all of creation, no animal is so pure, so perfect... There is much we can learn from them.

6.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_020
6.description: With each delivery you make, Bethric will come to hold you in higher <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>esteem<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

7.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_021
7.description: Deliver the items Bethric needs, and deliver them often to learn more about him and the amaro!

8.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_000
8.description: Thankfully the injuries he sustained were minor. The poison, however, is another matter entirely. It has to be flushed out of his system, and soon.

9.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_050
9.description: There you are, and not a moment too soon. After I've tested its efficacy, I'll begin administering the antidote right away.

10.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_051
10.description: There you are, and not a moment too soon. At a glance I can tell this is of exceptional quality, but I'll leave nothing to chance. After I've tested its efficacy, I'll begin administering the antidote right away.

11.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_100
11.description: It looks like Skip is going to pull through, and it's all thanks to you.

12.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_101
12.description: Ah, you weren't here for that, were you? He may reside here at the Crystarium for some time, and we thought it best to give him a name. Being a skipper from the Berube region, we thought “Skip” to be a suitable moniker.

13.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_102
13.description: We're not quite out of the woods yet, but if we continue treatments, the poison should be gone from his system soon enough.

14.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_103
14.description: Though I must say, I did not expect you to be such an accomplished apothecary. Indeed, the antidote's effectiveness has exceeded all my expectations.

15.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_104
15.description: In my experience, such exemplary work only comes from one deeply concerned for the well-being of their patients, and it certainly shows here.

16.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_105
16.description: Truly, you are an inspiration. Would that I had met you in my youth. Perhaps then I could have─<hex:02100103><sigh> Or perhaps not...

17.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_106
17.description: Pay no mind to my ramblings of the past. We can but focus on the present. That being the recovery of our dear Skip.

18.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_140
18.description: Hmmm. His recovery is proceeding apace, but there's still the matter of─

19.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_145
19.description: The next request will be available from Bethric upon reaching level 73 as an alchemist or culinarian.

21.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_151
21.description: I was just about to go and check on Skip, as well as administer another dose of your medicine. Care to join me?

22.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_152
22.description: The worst has passed, but he still has trouble eating on his own. Until he shows further improvement, I've decided to keep him on a mostly liquid diet.

23.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_153
23.description: Needless to say, we've kept him well hydrated, and our flavorful fare─such that it is─has somehow managed to keep up his appetite.

24.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_154
24.description: Your wounds are healing quite nicely, Skip.

25.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_155
25.description: Still, he needs lots of rest. I'll feel better once he's regained the strength to walk.

26.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_156
26.description: Though it still beggars belief that he's even here. An honest-to-gods Berube skipper...

27.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_157
27.description: Even assuming some few escaped the Flood all those years ago, their domestication should have left them ill-suited to survive in the wild.

28.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_158
28.description: Obviously Skip is proof to the contrary, but it begs the question: if they found sanctuary here in Norvrandt, why would he leave?

29.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_159
29.description: Was it a curiosity of people that led you to Lakeland?

30.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_160
30.description: I can only imagine your horror when you realized the poachers' intentions.

31.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_161
31.description: But enough fretting. Skip is safe now, and there's still much to be done to ensure his swift recovery.

33.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_163
33.description: I must thank you again for that antidote. It's proven surprisingly effective despite how little we know of his breed, and there have been no side effects from its usage.

34.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_164
34.description: However, because Skip has needed so much rest, it will be that much harder for him to regain his physical strength. Do you think it possible you could prepare dietary supplements for him?

35.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_165
35.description: Something easy on the stomach, but high in nutrition to help restore his stamina.

36.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_166
36.description: Truly you are a saint. I'll leave you to your work, then.

37.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_200
37.description: The sooner we can get Skip up and about, the better. We're counting on you for that supplement.

38.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_250
38.description: Wonderfully done, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Why, I'm tempted to sample this myself. In fact...I think I will!<hex:02100103>Mmm. Smooth texture. Rich flavor...and no doubt full to bursting with nutrients. Yes, yes, this will do nicely.

39.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_251
39.description: Wonderfully done, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Why, I'm tempted to sample this myself. In fact...I think I will!<hex:02100103>Oh my word, this is absolutely delicious! And no doubt full to bursting with nutrients. Yes, yes, this will do nicely.

40.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_300
40.description: This is more than enough to see Skip back on his feet. Thank you. He will be pleasantly surprised, I'm sure. More so if you should have time to pay him a visit.

41.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_301
41.description: <sigh> Oh, Skip... Whenever I look at him, I'm reminded of my youth.

42.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_302
42.description: Despite my appearance now, I was rather foolhardy in my day.

43.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_303
43.description: What a time that was. Diving headlong into the thick of battle, axe in hand astride my faithful amaro.

44.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_304
44.description: Every job was carried out to the letter, by any means necessary. There was nothing I wouldn't do for a bit of coin. “The Headsman,” they used to call me.

45.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_305
45.description: But that's all in the past.

46.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_306
46.description: I am a veterinarian, motivated not by coin, but my love of amaro.

47.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_307
47.description: And as a fellow enthusiast, I hope I can turn to you again in the future should I have need of assistance.

48.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_320
48.description: The next request will be available from Bethric upon reaching level 75 as an alchemist or culinarian.

49.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_350
49.description: Ahhh! You really shouldn't sneak up on me like that. It wouldn't do to leave the Crystarium's amaro without their veterinarian.

50.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_351
50.description: But since you're here, would you care to join me on a trip to the rookery? I think you'll be happy to see how Skip's condition has improved.

51.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_352
51.description: He's not yet able to fly, but it's quite a relief to see him walking again.

52.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_353
52.description: We'll need to keep a close eye on him, and adjust his diet as his condition improves.

53.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_354
53.description: Speaking of which─Skip! It's time to eat!

56.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_357
56.description: He refuses to eat anything unless I or one of the stablehands taste it first.

57.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_358
57.description: It's all right, Skip. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> prepared this especially for you.

58.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_359
58.description: That's the way. Keep eating like that, and you'll build back your strength in no time at all.

59.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_360
59.description: Would that his heart could be so easily mended. In light of his ordeal, I can understand his apprehension at the approach of our stablehands, but even the presence of other amaro leave him in a panic.

60.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_361
60.description: It would be foolish to return him to the wild in his present state, but to continue caring for him here would prove no less difficult for him.

61.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_362
61.description: Every day I feed him, I tend to his wounds, yet he refuses to so much as glance in my direction.

62.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_363
62.description: Wh-What's this!? He would allow you to gaze into those limpid pools of raven black?

63.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_364
63.description: Could it be he's finally ready to open his heart to us? To me?

64.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_365
64.description: Come, Skip! Let's show <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> the true strength of our friendship!

66.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_367
66.description: Well... It seems, at least, he's regained the spring in his step.

67.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_368
67.description: Perhaps we should return to the Mean. There's still more work to be done.

69.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_370
69.description: I suspect you hear this quite often, but I cannot thank you enough for all your help. Were it in my power, I would hire you as my personal apothecary.

70.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_371
70.description: I could finally rest easy knowing the amaro had quality fare.

71.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_372
71.description: T-That's not to say we fail to take good care of them, mind you. But there's no denying the fruits of your work.

72.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_373
72.description: As a matter of fact, your supplements have already done wonders for Skip's stomach. His appetite has returned and his bowel function is markedly improved.

73.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_374
73.description: Which is why I believe it is time we move to the next stage in his treatment.

74.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_375
74.description: Having rested for so long, I suspect Skip's muscles suffer from some degree of atrophy. Which is why I need you to create a new supplement to help strengthen his muscles. Are you up to the challenge?

75.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_400
75.description: It shouldn't be long before Skip is fit to fly again, and your supplements will help him recover that much faster.

76.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_450
76.description: How is it you make something so simple seem such a delicacy? I believe this warrants another sampling.<hex:02100103>Mmmm. Quite palatable, and no doubt full of the nutrition Skip needs. Well done.

77.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_451
77.description: How is it you make something so simple seem such a delicacy? I believe this warrants another sampling.<hex:02100103>Oh my, yes, this is fantastic! If it is as nutritious as it is delicious─and I have no reason to believe it isn't─Skip is in for a treat.

78.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_500
78.description: This should be more than enough to see Skip to a full recovery.

79.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_501
79.description: He's grown quite fond of mealtime, you know. Though I think that's mostly to do with your handiwork. You should see the way he perks up at the mere mention of your name.

80.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_502
80.description: ...But I worry what will happen when you're gone, and another sickly amaro is brought to the stables.

81.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_503
81.description: When it falls to me to prepare the medicine needed for their convalescence.

83.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_A1_000_001
83.description: Don't you usually prepare their medicine?

84.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_A1_000_002
84.description: Not fond of cooking, I take it?

85.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_504
85.description: A part of me hoped you would never think to ask me that...

86.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_505
86.description: Quite the contrary. Supply me with four eggs and I can cook the greatest omelette that will ever pass your lips. My recipe for baked beans is also rather popular. But...I know that is not what you meant, is it?

87.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_506
87.description: I suppose there's no harm in telling you.

88.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_507
88.description: As I mentioned once before, I once enjoyed the companionship of an amaro, back when I still worked as a mercenary. We were inseparable.

89.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_508
89.description: Until one fateful day when he was gravely wounded trying to protect me from sin eaters. I brought him back here to the Crystarium with all haste, but resources were scarce, and a caretaker for amaro was unheard of, let alone a proper veterinarian.

90.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_509
90.description: So I took matters into my own hands, using my personal store of medical supplies.

91.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_510
91.description: It wasn't until he began convulsing that I realized the dosage was too strong. I could only watch in horror as he thrashed about in pain─screaming, pleading for help.

93.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_512
93.description: I swore then and there no man or beast would die by my hands ever again. The next day, I traded in my axe for books to learn all there is to know of amaro and their care.

94.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_513
94.description: That said, I've always been of the belief that any medicine to be administered should be prepared by one adept in the arts.

95.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_514
95.description: After seeing all you've done to help Skip, I'm beginning to think I have more studying to do.

96.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_515
96.description: Speaking of Skip, there's something I wished to discuss with you, but I fear I've taken up enough of your time as it is. Why don't you come back later, after you've had a bit of rest?

97.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_516
97.description: A new quest continuing the story of Bethric and the amaro is now available.

98.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_540
98.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Pray give me a moment for my heart to return to my chest...

99.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_545
99.description: The next request will be available from Bethric upon reaching level 78 as an alchemist or culinarian.

100.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_550
100.description: I was on my way back here when I happened to peek down at the stables and I saw him. I saw Skip! Quickly, we must go and see him!

101.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_551
101.description: Skip! By the gods, it's really you!

102.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_552
102.description: But why would he return? You don't suppose the amaro of Wolekdorf mistreated him, do you?

103.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_553
103.description: No... No, they were quite nice.

104.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_554
104.description: But I want to live here with you, Bethric, and <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

106.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_556
106.description: The Tupaq Amaro in Wolekdorf spoke true! You <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> have the gift!

107.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_557
107.description: I'm sorry for not speaking sooner. It was not my intention to deceive you.

108.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_558
108.description: You have nothing to apologize for. Were I in your position, I likely would have done the same.

109.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_559
109.description: I still can't believe you're here.

110.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_560
110.description: What exactly happened after we left you at Wolekdorf?

111.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_561
111.description: I spoke with the other amaro of the poachers and their poison. Of your kindness, and how you nursed me back to health. Sensing the conflict in my heart, they bade me think long and hard on what it was I truly desired.

112.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_562
112.description: For nigh on a century I have longed for the companionship I once shared with man. Yet it was not until I encountered the poachers that I became truly aware of his capacity for cruelty. I began to think, perhaps, all men secretly harbored such wickedness within them.

113.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_563
113.description: Then I thought of <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, and the food <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> so lovingly made for me. It reminded me of my youth, and the partner with whom I once explored the world.

114.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_564
114.description: It reminded me that I must endeavor to seek the good in men's hearts.

115.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_565
115.description: And I can think of no better place to do that than here at the Crystarium. If...you will have me.

116.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_566
116.description: I can see no reason why not? What say you, Knem?

117.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_KNEMCHELEIMIN_100_566
117.description: I would welcome Skip without question, but it is not a decision for me to make alone. I must discuss this with the other stablehands.

119.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_568
119.description: Think nothing of it...<hex:02100103>Ah! A thought occurs to me. If you were to stay here at the stables, would you be able to tell us what the other amaro are thinking?

120.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_569
120.description: Indeed I could. I recall them being rather jealous of the food I ate when last I was here, though they understood it was part of my treatment.

121.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_570
121.description: Truly? Have they said anything about me?

122.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_571
122.description: Erm... Why would they have anything to say of you?

123.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SKIP_000_572
123.description: Speaking of foods─<hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, is there any chance you could prepare any of the foods from my homeland? I'm sure they would love it.

124.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_573
124.description: What a splendid idea! Nothing brings together people─or, I suppose in this case, amaro─like a delicious meal.

125.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_574
125.description: How about it, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Think you can prepare amaro fare in the Berube fashion?

126.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_575
126.description: I will put together a list of necessary ingredients. As this is a rather special request, you can be sure your efforts will be handsomely rewarded.

127.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_600
127.description: Isn't Skip's voice simply divine? Oh, I could listen to him talk all day...

128.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_650
128.description: You've outdone yourself, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You don't mind if I have a taste, do you?<hex:02100103>Mmm. It tastes exactly as Skip said it would! Your prowess continues to inspire.

129.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_651
129.description: You've outdone yourself, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You don't mind if I have a taste, do you?<hex:02100103>Goodness me! The amaro of Berube must have lived like kings! Your prowess continues to inspire.

130.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_700
130.description: Expertly done! I had better hurry this over to the stables before I'm tempted to sample more.

131.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_701
131.description: You'll still go and visit Skip from time to time, won't you? I'm sure it would mean the world to him.

132.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_702
132.description: It does my heart good to see the amaro so happy and healthy. I would do anything to keep them safe.

133.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_703
133.description: Though I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried about another poacher attack. There won't always be a craftsman on hand to mix the medicines I require.

135.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_A2_000_001
135.description: I'm certain you'll find a way.

136.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_A2_000_002
136.description: I never took you for a quitter.

137.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_704
137.description: Ever the optimist, I see. Well, I said I would do anything to keep them safe, and I meant it.

138.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_705
138.description: I think it's high time I began studying medicine in earnest. For Skip and the others.

139.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_706
139.description: Speaking of whom, Knem said she wished to speak with me about Skip staying at the Crystarium. If you've a mind to hear what she has to say, would you care to join me?

140.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_707
140.description: A new quest continuing the story of Bethric and the amaro is now available. Speak with Bethric as a culinarian or alchemist level 80 or above to undertake the quest.

141.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_750
141.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Checking up on me, are you?

142.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_751
142.description: Hahaha, have no fear. I will master the mixing of medicines yet!

143.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_800
143.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.

144.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_850
144.description: In order to make deliveries, you must be an alchemist or culinarian.

145.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_900
145.description: The Crystarium Deliveries list for Bethric has been updated.

146.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_910
146.description: Bethric is pleased with your efforts. He now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Amaro Enthusiast<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

147.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_920
147.description: Bethric is delighted with your efforts. He now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Amaro Lover<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

148.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_930
148.description: Bethric is overjoyed with your efforts. He now considers you an <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Amaro Aficionado<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

150.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_SYSTEM_000_935

151.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_950
151.description: I cannot deny my consternation when first seeing the night sky, but I must confess it is quite beautiful. Though perhaps not quite as beautiful as the stars in Skip's eyes...

152.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_960
152.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I've heard your collaborative tools with Chora-Zoi met with great success, and now all of Norvrandt shall soon bask in their splendor.

153.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_961
153.description: Though my focus lies in medicine, I am still a proud member of the Mean, and prouder still to have served a small part in your project.

154.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER3_00569_BETHRIC_000_962
154.description: Why, just think of the possibilities! With such adaptive tools, we could create all manner of new medicines, and delight in healthier lives with our precious amaro! Yes, there is much to look forward to indeed.
